sample.question: This game is called Chess Ranger. The rules are as follows:Pieces move like in standard chess.You can only perform capture moves.The king is allowed to be captured.The goal is to end up with a single piece remaining on the board.The possible first step to be tried is the following 4 steps：1.move Rook in b3 to capture Pawn in b5,2.move Pawn in a4 to capture Pawn in b5,3.move Rook in b3 to capture Knight in b2,4.move Knight in b2 to capture Pawn in a4.What is the first step to be tried now in order to finally solve the puzzle?Choose the number combination from the following options:A.12,B.13,C.234,D.23,E.34,F.123,G.1,H.None
sample.analysis: The current board situation is:Pawn at b5.Pawn at a4.Rook at b3.Knight at b2.In the process of solving the puzzle, we have 2 operations and 2 flags to analysis:operation Try indicates the execution of a step, operation Backtrack indicates that the capture operation performed by the last Try step is withdrawn; flag Fail indicates all tries have failed in the current case, flag Success indicates that the puzzle is solved.The tried steps after tring option 1 are as follows:Try step 1: move Rook in b5 to capture Knight in b2.Fail: No moves left with 2 pieces.Backtrack step 1: move Rook from b2 to b5 and release Knight back to b2.Try step 1: move Pawn in a4 to capture Rook in b5.Fail: No moves left with 2 pieces.Backtrack step 1: move Pawn from b5 to a4 and release Rook back to b5.Try step 1: move Knight in b2 to capture Pawn in a4.Fail: No moves left with 2 pieces.Backtrack step 1: move Knight from a4 to b2 and release Pawn back to a4.Fail: No moves left with 3 pieces.So the option 1 is wrong.The tried steps after tring option 2 are as follows:Try step 1: move Rook in b3 to capture Pawn in b5.Try step 2: move Rook in b5 to capture Knight in b2.Success: Only one piece remains.So the option 2 is right.The tried steps after tring option 3 are as follows:Try step 1: move Pawn in a4 to capture Pawn in b5.Try step 2: move Rook in b2 to capture Pawn in b5.Success: Only one piece remains.So the option 3 is right.The tried steps after tring option 4 are as follows:Try step 1: move Rook in b3 to capture Pawn in b5.Fail: No moves left with 2 pieces.Backtrack step 1: move Rook from b5 to b3 and release Pawn back to b5.Fail: No moves left with 3 pieces.So the option 4 is wrong.So the answer is 23.So the answer letter is D.
